notes.title: Version 0.0.8 Update
notes.content: [olist][*][p][b]11 New Weapons Added[/b]: Micro Missile Launcher, Sticky Bomb Bow, Flamethrower, Frost Launcher, Venom Sprayer, Laser Gun, Ray Gun, Sonic Gun, Railgun, Aura Gun, and Crossbow.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weapon Quality System[/b]: Dropped weapons now have random qualities. High-quality weapons will come with randomly generated affixes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Gameplay Option[/b]: Added an option in the settings menu to enable or disable automatically switching back to the starter pistol when out of ammo.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimizations & Bug Fixes[/b]: Implemented performance optimizations and fixed several known bugs.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Demo v0.0.7 Update
notes.content: [p](1) Significantly increased the reflect damage of Character "Huang"'s stance skill.[/p][p](2) Added a short period of invincibility after Character "Huang"'s stance ends.[/p][p](3) Weakened the charge effect of the Level 2 wild boar.[/p]

notes.title: Demo v0.0.6 Update
notes.content: [olist][*][p]Fixed a bug that occurred when refreshing mutation skills after they reached the max level of 5.[/p][/*][*][p]All blade shockwaves can no longer pass through walls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where crystals could not be picked up.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Demo v0.0.5 Update
notes.content: [olist][*][p]Fixed a bug where the boss's skill animations were not playing correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the boar boss's charge skill could incorrectly destroy indestructible boundary walls.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced the background music for the second boss battle.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Demo v0.0.4 Update
notes.content: [olist][*][p]Added a new UI notification for ultimate ability readiness.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized bullet/projectile performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Character 1 could revive while rolling.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Demo v0.0.3 Upgrade
notes.content: [olist][*][p]Changed boss phase-transition rewards to drop upon taking damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed binding and display issues for certain keys.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug in the tutorial level that prevented reloading and caused issues with the main weapon's rate of fire.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Demo v0.0.2 Update Notes
notes.content: [olist][*][p][b]New Mechanic:[/b] The "Splitting Bugs" in Level 1 can now be executed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Adjustments:[/b] Slightly reduced the rocket projectile speed for Boss 1 during Phase 2.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Character Balance:[/b] Increased the melee basic attack damage for the character "Ah Huang".[/p][/*][*][p][b]QoL Improvement:[/b] Expanded the vertical camera follow range to provide a wider field of view.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Fixed several known bugs and made general performance optimizations.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Dev Log #1: A Swift Blade Joins the Fray! Introducing Ah Huang!
notes.content: [p]ːsteamhappyːGreetings, adventurers!ːsteamhappyː[/p][p]We're back with another exciting development update, and this one has some serious bite! We're thrilled to officially introduce the second hero joining our roster: the canine warrior, [b]Ah Huang[/b]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621593/2bed1c75f78aa56f5b5dfa8d634901f207e5367a.png"][/img][/p][p]ːsteammockingːA Whirlwind of Steelːsteammockingː[/p][p]Ah Huang is a loyal and lightning-fast fighter, a stark contrast to our first hero. His specialty is overwhelming enemies with a [b]flurry of rapid, wide-arcing slashes[/b] from his blade. He excels at crowd control, dancing through waves of foes and clearing a path with incredible speed. If you love fast-paced, high-action combat, Ah Huang will be your new best friend![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621593/ae15d924c7b52246292af556587cdadc02f713f6.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621593/18638cccfc60a6aedcc5da381797d4a30b2b85ef.png"][/img][/p][p]ːsteamthisːDevelopment Progress Updateːsteamthisː[/p][p]We've also hit a major milestone! The development of our first two heroes (including Ah Huang) and the [b]first two full levels of the game are now content-complete[/b].[/p][p]Our current focus is on polishing the experience. This means we're deep into [b]performance optimization[/b] to ensure the game runs smoothly, and we're hunting down and [b]squashing every bug[/b] we can find. Our goal is to get a playable [b]Demo[/b] into your hands as soon as possible![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621593/2542bbc4ac9c8febf74edbef43c149d81eb825a6.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p]ːsteamhappyːWishlist Now to Stay Updated!ːsteamhappyːYour support means the world to us. The best way to help and to get notified the moment the demo drops is by adding our game to your Wishlist![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3702140/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Let us know in the comments what you think of Ah Huang![/p][p]Stay sharp,[/p][p]\[Gunblade Ranger/Astral Flow Games][/p]
